name: Agatha's Soul Cauldron — creatures with +1/+1 counters gain abilities of creature cards exiled with it
notes: Memory: project_exile_zone_implementation (Agatha's 'exiled with this card' form, no 'you own'). exile_1 Elves is tagged to the Cauldron; exile_2 Birds is in exile but not tagged. Only creatures with a +1/+1 counter gain the Elves ability, so the countered Bear gets it, the plain Runeclaw Bear does not, and nobody gets Birds' ability. NOTE: exile ids are literal; build in its own process.
